findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Gate. Case: normal use - merging this guide-delivery part also adds designs for the agent-account screens and Agent access dialog. The ten files under docs/design/FORGE-MCP-1/ (CHECKS.md, SCREENS.md, four HTML artboards and four PNGs) fall outside this part's Scope and are not needed to deliver or test the guide text through init, sync and work. Keep those screen-design additions with the task that owns the screens; the stated records exemption does not include these design files.
